title: Applying Full-Frame Photography
slide_intent: Make legibility a condition of image-led composition because text loses its role when the background overwhelms it.
strategic_value: A close-up tomato can carry Burger King’s food character while cream typography and a small signature keep the communication identifiable.
demonstration: A tomato photograph fills a landscape example behind the headline, subhead, body line and logo, with grid guides retained.
practical_value: Use a full-background photograph only when the type hierarchy and sufficient contrast survive.

content_islands.name: Full-frame condition
content_islands.spec: Place the short conditional guidance at left.

content_islands.name: Image-led composition
content_islands.spec: Fill the example with tomato texture; keep cream type in the right-hand area and the logo at bottom right.

ingredient.name: Full-frame photograph
ingredient.role: Create an immersive food image while keeping information readable.
ingredient.application: Allow the photograph to span all four corners only while maintaining the type system and sufficient contrast.
ingredient.scope: Historical 2020 partner guidelines, PDF produced January 2021. The source states no numeric contrast threshold on this page.

reference_purposes.Application: The example overlays the type system and logo on a photograph reaching all four corners.
reference_purposes.Constraint: The copy permits the approach only if the type system is maintained and contrast is sufficient.
